measurement_notes: Retained measurements; importing evidence does not qualify an AKAS deployment. All values are medians. Phase protocol labels describe the measured boundaries. client-stream-burst-v1 uses concurrent token-arrival timestamps: TTFT includes queueing and prefill rate is total prompt tokens divided by maximum TTFT. native-gpu-prefill-ar127-v1 uses CUDA events around native prefill and autoregressive decode. Column labels distinguish native engine delivery, CUDA events and HTTP/SSE transports. Decode counts the remaining output tokens after the first. Unqualified values retain †. Original run records and source snapshots are unchanged.
qualification_notes: AKAS: the retained H200 run passed its recorded checks. The [L40S follow-up numerical qualification](https://github.com/kreasof-ai/akas/blob/8ce8c3da31b2c74f0cd757be3bf152b2e25bc239/benchmarks/runs/20261101113717922004-dcb7262b/run.json) passed against vLLM, SGLang and FP64 references, with 8/8 first-token agreement for both BOS and chat prompt sets. † means this changed H200 AOT program has not yet repeated that qualification; it does not erase the L40S result.

vLLM: one request at C256 changed its greedy output between repetitions, causing the run-level repeatability check to fail. All requests completed 128 tokens. The frozen timing samples remain in the tables; the run-level marker also appears on the other shapes.
